benefit: Carrots direct-sown between tomato rows occupy the bed during the slow early-tomato growth period and are mostly harvested before tomatoes shade them out. Maximizes square-foot productivity for small-acreage growers.

members.title: Carrot sown 2 weeks before tomato transplant
members.body: Direct-sow carrots in the bed two weeks before tomato transplant. Harvest most by mid-tomato season. Leave a few for fall pull.
